title: acs/cycle50 has two permanently-RED predicates: they assert on go/cmd/evolve/cmd_release_preflight.go, which no longer exists (the CLI moved to internal/cli/opscmd/release_preflight.go)
problem: TestC50B_002_ReleaseStrictPass_AbsentFromReleasePreflight and TestC50B_005_StrictPassFlag_RegisteredInPreflight both resolve go/cmd/evolve/cmd_release_preflight.go and fail with `no such file or directory`. That file was moved to go/internal/cli/opscmd/release_preflight.go and the predicates were never repointed. Verified pre-existing and unrelated to any current work: the same two tests fail identically on the untouched runtime plane at current main, and `git show HEAD:go/cmd/evolve/cmd_release_preflight.go` is absent. A FileContains predicate whose target does not exist can never go green again — it is a dead gate, and the repo's own rule is that a false-RED gate must have its own logic verified before anyone concludes the code is broken.
impact: Low blast radius today because the per-cycle acs/cycleN snapshots are NOT in the durable tier (Makefile test-acs-durable and the ci.yml acs-durable job both run ./acs/regression/... only), so CI stays green. The cost is that anyone running the per-cycle suites locally — which the decomposition campaign's own per-slice verification recipe does — hits an unexplained RED and has to re-derive that it is stale.
fix: Repoint both predicates at go/internal/cli/opscmd/release_preflight.go, OR, if the --strict-pass migration they were written to enforce is long since complete (check: the flag is registered and EVOLVE_RELEASE_STRICT_PASS is gone from the CLI), retire the two predicates as satisfied rather than leaving them asserting on a path that cannot exist.
acceptance: `go test -count=1 -tags acs ./acs/cycle50/` is green, or the two stale predicates are removed with a recorded reason.
Any predicate that resolves a source path fails with a message naming the MOVED-file possibility, not just 'no such file'.
A sweep confirms no other acs/cycleN predicate points at a path that no longer exists.
notes: Found while running the per-slice verification recipe for the releasepreflight decomposition slice. Not caused by that change: its diff is confined to internal/releasepreflight.
